case_title: RAVADA SASIKALA v. STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH & ANR.
aggravating_circumstances: Acid attack on a young girl
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 326 and 448 IPC, sentenced to one year RI with fine
high_court_outcome: Modified the sentence to the period already undergone, that is 30 days
neutral_facts: The accused, a young man, trespassed into the victim's house and poured acid over her head after his marriage proposal was rejected. The victim sustained severe disfigurement as a result of the acid attack. The investigating agency filed a charge sheet based on the FIR and the medical evidence confirmed the acid attack. The trial court convicted the accused under Sections 326 and 448 of the IPC and sentenced him to one year of rigorous imprisonment with a fine. The High Court reduced the sentence to the period already undergone, which was 30 days. The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's decision, stating that the sentence was inadequate given the nature of the crime and restored the trial court's sentence.
